## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] `dotnet format`, `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` pass (and `npm test` for changes in `sdk/js` or `sdk/elements`)
- [ ] The OpenAPI snapshot, JavaScript types and migrations are updated, if the API or schema changed
- [ ] Docs and the `[Unreleased]` section of CHANGELOG.md say what users and operators notice
